# Golden Gate IPTV

> Golden Gate IPTV is an IPTV service for viewers in the USA: live TV channels and on-demand movies and series over the internet, on Smart TV, Fire TV Stick, Android, iPhone, Windows and Mac. IPTV subscription plans start at $7 for one day and $20 for one month, with a 7-day refund, 24/7 support on WhatsApp and premium plans for up to 5 screens.

## Key facts
- Standard IPTV subscription (1 screen): 1 day $7, 1 month $20, 3 months $37, 6 months $49, 1 year $77, 2 years $119.
- Premium IPTV (1 year): 1 connection $77, 2 connections $119, 3 connections $149, 4 connections $189, 5 connections $229.
- Included in every plan: live TV by genre, on-demand movies and series, TV guide (EPG), free updates, HD and 4K where the source supports it.
- Refund: 7 days from purchase. A free trial can be requested on the free trial page.
- Orders and support: WhatsApp +212 707 711 512, email goldengateiptv@gmail.com.
- Last updated: 2026-10-06.
